rows.grounds: compound adjective describing something never previously seen
compound with indeclinable particle api indicating mere hearing
predicate adjective expressing difficulty of attainment

items.question: Why is the supreme image described as unseen before and difficult to attain?
premises: The supreme image has never been seen before.
The supreme image is known only through hearing.
What is merely heard and never seen is rare.
items.inference: Therefore the supreme image is exceedingly rare and difficult to attain.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the image depends on the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: O Goddess-lord, that supreme image is unseen before, known only by hearing, and rare.
